curation.notes: Blood isolate from 2018. Found via ST131 search term. O25:H4 serotype expected based on ST131 correlation. Assembly not available - generate locally. Metadata confidence medium pending serotype/ST verification from tool runs.

reads.download_cmd: fasterq-dump --gzip --outdir data/ SRR13220449 && mv data/SRR13220449_1.fastq.gz data/reads_1.fq.gz && mv data/SRR13220449_2.fastq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz

assembly.notes: Assembly not available in NCBI. Generate locally: spades.py -1 data/reads_1.fq.gz -2 data/reads_2.fq.gz -o assembly/ --careful && cp assembly/contigs.fasta data/contigs.fa

validation_instructions.serological: Expected serotype O25:H4. This is the typical serotype for ST131 ExPEC. Accept exact match 'O25:H4', 'O25b:H4' (subgroup notation). Tool should detect both O25 and H4. If serotype differs significantly, flag for manual review - may indicate non-ST131 isolate.
validation_instructions.mlst: Expected ST131 (E. coli scheme), the pandemic ExPEC clone responsible for fluoroquinolone-resistant UTIs globally. All 7 loci must be typed: adk(6), fumC(4), gyrB(14), icd(1), mdh(20), purA(7), recA(7). Accept exact ST131 match. Also accept ST1193 as PARTIAL - it is a single-locus variant at fumC, closely related to ST131.

notes: ST131 is the dominant ExPEC clone worldwide. O25:H4 serotype is typical. Blood isolate suggests ExPEC pathotype. Assembly must be generated locally from reads. Verify ST and serotype correlation after tool runs.
